ui_bugs.issue: ESLint compile error: 'Definition for rule react-hooks/exhaustive-deps was not found react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' at src/components/shared/InviteStatsCard.js:71. The overlay covers the entire page in dev and intercepts pointer events, so all chip clicks are swallowed. Root cause: the file contains an `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` directive on line 71 but the project's ESLint config does NOT have eslint-plugin-react-hooks loaded (CRA preset is partial). Fix options: (a) remove the disable directive and refactor effect deps, (b) ensure plugin is registered in eslintConfig.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/components/shared/InviteStatsCard.js line 71 contains `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`. The project's ESLint configuration (CRA default) does not register the eslint-plugin-react-hooks rule, so when the disable directive is encountered, eslint throws 'Definition for rule "react-hooks/exhaustive-deps" was not found'. CRA dev-server elevates this to a compile error and renders a fullscreen overlay iframe that intercepts ALL pointer events. As a side-effect, every Playwright force-click reaches the overlay first and React state never updates → no network requests are fired for chip clicks/CSV download. REPRO: yarn start; navigate to any page; observe red overlay 'Compiled with problems'. MITIGATION: remove the disable directive (the deps array `[period]` is actually correct — fetchStats is in scope and uses period as captured value; no warning will fire); OR add `'react-hooks': require('eslint-plugin-react-hooks')` to .eslintrc plugins. Once removed, all 4 frontend flows should pass.
